title: Oven Roasted Indian Turkey Neck Curry
description: A flavorful and aromatic Indian-inspired dish featuring turkey neck, served in a cataplana vessel, this meal is perfect for a special occasion or a cozy night in.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large cataplana vessel, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to brown.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for an additional minute.
Add the curry powder and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the turkey neck and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the coconut milk, pasta water, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Cover the cataplana vessel and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Roast the turkey neck in the oven for 2 hours, or until it is tender and falling off the bone.
Remove the cataplana vessel from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
